title: In 2020, a Michigan dam failure drained Sanford Lake; six years later, the water returned and...
summary_full: Sanford Lake has triumphantly regained its full water levels following a devastating dam failure. This notable recovery paved the way for a cherished local beach festival to return, rejuvenating community spirits. However, the dam incident unveiled significant issues with aged infrastructure, leading to prolonged challenges. Overcoming these setbacks demanded extensive engineering efforts and hundreds of millions in funding. The lake's revival heralds a pivotal phase of economic resurgence for mid-Michigan.
